messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

Each morning, the files which have yet to be processed need to be checked, to make sure they are in order for the court hearing that day. If some files are missing, a search is initiated, otherwise the files can be physically tracked to the intended location. Once all the files are ready, these are handed to the Associate, and meantime the Judgeis Lawlist is distributed to the relevant people. Afterwards, the directions hearings are conducted.

response.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="CourtFilePreparationProcess" name="Court File Preparation Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Morning Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckFiles" name="Check files for order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FilesStatus" name="Are files missing?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Missing</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Present</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SearchFiles" name="Initiate search for missing files">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Missing</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SearchDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackFiles" name="Physically track files to location">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Present</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrackDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ConvergeFiles" name="Files Ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SearchDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrackDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Handover</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandToAssociate" name="Hand files to Associate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Handover</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DistributeLawList</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeLawList" name="Distribute Judge's Law List">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DistributeLawList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConductHearings</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductHearings" name="Conduct directions hearings">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConductHearings</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="Process Complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_CheckFiles" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckFiles" targetRef="Gateway_FilesStatus" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Missing" name="Yes, Missing" sourceRef="Gateway_FilesStatus" targetRef="Task_SearchFiles">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Present" name="No, Present" sourceRef="Gateway_FilesStatus" targetRef="Task_TrackFiles">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SearchDone" sourceRef="Task_SearchFiles" targetRef="Gateway_ConvergeFiles" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackDone" sourceRef="Task_TrackFiles" targetRef="Gateway_ConvergeFiles" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Handover" sourceRef="Gateway_ConvergeFiles" targetRef="Task_HandToAssociate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistributeLawList" sourceRef="Task_HandToAssociate" targetRef="Task_DistributeLawList" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConductHearings" sourceRef="Task_DistributeLawList" targetRef="Task_ConductHearings" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_End" sourceRef="Task_ConductHearings" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
